DML.SELECT: SELECT task_type_id as "taskTypeId", task_type_param_id as "taskTypeParamId", incident_type_task_id as "incidentTypeTaskId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_type_task_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_type_task_values (task_type_id, task_type_param_id, incident_type_task_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:taskTypeId, :taskTypeParamId, :incidentTypeTaskId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_type_task_values SET value = :value, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_type_task_id = :id
